notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Phainon is a Bounce/AoE DPS with a transformation. When he is the target of any ability, he gains a "Coreflame", with an upper limit of 15. At 12 "Coreflame"s, he can use his ultimate to deploy a zone and transform into Khaslana. Khaslana will depart all other allies and his speed is set to 60% of Phainons base speed.

✦ Khaslana has an Enhanced Basic ATK and 2 Enhanced Skills. When using his Enhanced Basic ATK or first Enhanced Skill, he gains "Scourge" with an upper limit of 7. Using the second Enhanced Skill consumes 1-4 points of "Scourge", dealing Bounce DMG to random enemies. When consuming 4 points, the skill will deal an additional massive burst of damage. 

✦ Khaslana gains 8 turns when transformed. On his last turn he will deal AOE damage to all enemies then detransform into Phainon.

**Investment Priority**

**E2 > Cerydra > S1**

**Investment Explanation**

✦ His E2 is instrumental for his damage output in endgame scenarios, allowing him to effectively take double the turns when using his second Enhanced Skill. This will be your number one priority when planning to invest into him.

✦ Cerydra is able to double some of his damage output with her utility, as well as being able to generate "Coreflame"s consistently with her E1.

✦ His S1 improves his consistency by allowing Khaslana to take his turns faster, along with the additonal buffs it provides.

**Ability Rotation**

**Phainon**

Skill Spam - Basic ATK if needed

**Khaslana**

Basic ATK with 1-2 enemies, Skill 1 with 3-5 enemies, Skill 2 with 4+ "Scourge"
